zh: 以使接触（或相结合）；到一起
en: with or near to somebody/something else; with each other
ex: We grew up together.
我们是在一块儿长大的。

zh: （尤指家庭或朋友的）和睦相处，亲密无间，团结友爱
en: the happy feeling you have when you are with people you like, especially family and friends
ex: By the end of the week, there was a tremendous feeling of togetherness in the group.
到一周结束时，团队成员之间洋溢着一种亲密无间的感情。

zh: （大衣或口袋等上木质或塑料的）栓扣钉，棒形纽扣，套索扣
en: a short piece of wood, plastic, etc. that is put through a loop of thread to fasten something, such as a coat or bag, instead of a button
an electrical switch that you move up and down or backwards and forwards
a country in western Africa

zh: 多哥人；多哥的；多哥人的
en: (a person) from Togo
to work very hard and/or for a long time, usually doing hard physical work
ex: Hundreds of men toiled for years at building the pyramid.
建这座金字塔，数百人苦干了多年。

en: a person who works very hard and/or for a long time, usually doing hard physical work

zh: （有几个分隔坐便器的）厕所间，厕所
en: a large bowl attached to a pipe that you sit on or stand over when you get rid of waste matter from your body
ex: Have you flushed the toilet?
你冲厕所了吗？

en: a small bag for holding your soap, toothbrush, etc. when you are travelling
thin, soft paper used for cleaning yourself after you have used the toilet

一卷卫生纸

en: a roll of toilet paper
soap that you use for washing yourself
a kind of perfume (= a pleasant-smelling liquid for the skin) that contains a lot of water and does not smell very strong
to teach a small child to use the toilet

en: knowing how to use the toilet
the process of teaching a small child to use the toilet
things such as soap or toothpaste that you use for washing, cleaning your teeth, etc.
a small bag for holding your soap, toothbrush, etc. when you are travelling
if you are caught in the toils of an unpleasant feeling or situation, you cannot escape from it

zh: 新美拉尼西亚语（巴布亚新几内亚使用的一种以英语为基础的克里奥尔语）
en: a Creole language based on English, used in Papua New Guinea

en: to breathe in smoke from a cigarette containing marijuana

zh: （用以启动某些机器或用作支付方式的）代币，专用辅币
（感觉、事实、事件等的）象征，标志，表示，信物
en: a round piece of metal or plastic used instead of money to operate some machines or as a form of payment
ex: a parking token
停车专用辅币

zh: 装点门面；表面文章；敷衍了事；应付差事
en: the fact of doing something only in order to do what the law requires or to satisfy a particular group of people, but not in a way that is really sincere
ex: Appointing one woman to the otherwise all-male staff could look like tokenism.
给原本清一色的男职员队伍增派一位女性会显得是装点门面。

zh: 托克洛希（传说中能趁人睡眠时进行伤害的邪恶精灵）
en: an evil imaginary creature that some people believe can harm you while you are sleeping
